description: Planned temporary road occupancies is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. The Brisbane City Council planned temporary road occupancies data is being made available to allow the use of this information to make informed travel choices such as planning alternative routes. This dataset includes information on construction zones, lane occupancies and planned events. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are api, close, closed, closure, road, traffic. The portal shows 229 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
